# RFP ACT JATEC 01-26

Request for Proposal (RFP) for Finance Governance Support Contractors.

**Bid closing date:** Bids shall be received at the JFTC Contracting Office **no later than 27 May 2026, 13:00 hours, Central European Time**. Bidders must ensure that the electronic proposal has sufficient time to make its way through any filters or email traffic. No bids shall be accepted after this time and date.

[**Click here to open RFP ACT JATEC 01-26**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/RFP-ACT-JATEC-01-26.pdf)

[**Click here to open RFP ACT JATEC 01-26 Editable Enclosures**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/RFP-ACT-JATEC-01-26_Enclosures.docx)
